platforms.name: Uber Eats
platforms.summary: Public store pages publish the whole menu with USD prices and the branch's street address as schema.org data, so each price is tied to one US branch.
evidence: Prices read from real US store pages in every live run since 37708779121 (up to 335 menu items per page); 36 branches in the 18:59 UTC snapshot.
Store links come from robots.txt-declared sitemaps and brand pages. Non-US country sections are skipped without a request.
A few store pages answered with a challenge. Those are counted as blocked and not worked around.

platforms.name: DoorDash
platforms.summary: Branch discovery works, but store pages answer datacenter requests with a Cloudflare challenge, so no DoorDash branch price could be read from a server.
evidence: 49 of 49 store-page requests across ten live runs returned 403 “Just a moment…”.
131 per-state store sitemaps are readable (California alone lists 106,228 store URLs).
/business/…/menu pages show prices DoorDash labels “estimated based on your predicted location”, so they are not used as branch prices.
In your own browser, the capture bookmarklet below can read a store page you open.

platforms.name: Grubhub
platforms.summary: Grubhub's restaurant pages are drawn by JavaScript and publish no prices. Two Grubhub-owned menu sites publish the same restaurants' menus with prices and link back to each Grubhub listing, so a menu is used only when it links to the same Grubhub restaurant ID.
evidence: MenuPages: Lou Malnati's, 6456 S Cicero Ave, Chicago (Grubhub ID 434510), 162 priced listings from its Menu JSON-LD. Its restaurant sitemap lists 28,133 pages.

AllMenus: Lou Malnati's, 85 S Buffalo Grove Rd (ID 517712, not on MenuPages), 169 priced listings. Prices are read from the page HTML only because its 217 item names match the page's own JSON-LD names.
AllMenus has 21 restaurant sitemaps of up to 40,000 pages each, read once a day to find a listing.
Published menu prices can lag the live Grubhub menu and leave out option charges. Grubhub's terms restrict automated access.
